name: Innovasport
note: Mexican sportswear retailer founded 1999 in Monterrey. In April 2025 it announced the purchase of Ecuador's Marathon Sports chain (operator Superdeporte S.A.); stake and price undisclosed (El Financiero, 2025-04-14; Vistazo, 2025-05-02). Family company: chaired by Francisco Martín Bringas and run by his sons Francisco and Juan Carlos Martín; unlike the family's Organización Soriana, it is not listed on the stock exchange and operates independently of it.
